investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads was observed from Kevin.Smit@globalcorp.ee, totaling 2,100 files in the last 24 hours, well above the baseline of 40. The activity targeted the Production_Backups_RECOVERY site and used Python-urllib/3.12, with sample files including PROD_SQL_DUMP_JAN_2026.bak, Customer_Encryption_Keys.txt, and Global_Sales_Database_Export.sql. The source appears to be 109.70.100.1 communicating with 40.108.201.15, indicating data leaving the network and potential exfiltration of sensitive data; the combination of external destination, high volume, and sensitive sample files supports escalating this as HP for immediate investigation.
